services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: BETHLEHEM, Pa. - The National Museum of Industrial History (NMIH) and Historic Bethlehem Museums & Sites (HBMS) have partnered to offer a new educational field trip experience that brings Bethlehem’s remarkable story of innovation, industry, and community to life for students. “Forging the Future” combines the expertise of both organizations to examine more than 250 years of local history-from the ingenuity of Bethlehem’s Moravian founders in the 1700s through the rise of Bethlehem Steel and its lasting impact on the region and the nation.
